the-tabernacle--the-tabernacle-ct-broadl.description: Released by Foundation Cigar Co. in 2016 and rolled at A.J. Fernandez in Estelí, The Tabernacle pairs a dark Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper with a Mexican San Andrés binder and filler from Honduras's Jamastrán Valley and Nicaragua's Estelí and Jalapa. The smoke is dense and full-bodied, with mocha, black pepper and a dark, dried-fruit sweetness; one for the evening.

thirds.notes: Mocha and red pepper lead with cedar behind and a creamy texture; the pepper is sharper through the nose.
The mocha darkens toward black coffee, while earth and a soft dried-fruit sweetness settle in underneath.
Pepper and cedar move forward as the coffee recedes; dark fruit and a long, oily finish close it out.

the-tabernacle--the-tabernacle-havana-se.description: Introduced by Foundation Cigar Co. in 2018, this Tabernacle swaps Broadleaf for a Connecticut-grown Havana Seed No. 142 wrapper, given an extended fermentation, over a San Andrés binder and Nicaraguan and Honduran filler, all rolled at A.J. Fernandez. Medium in strength but generous in flavor, it moves between coffee, earth, orange-like sweetness and pepper.

thirds.notes: Coffee and earth up front, with red pepper and a sweet orange note behind and a creamy feel on the palate.
Pepper builds steadily while earth and orange trade places; cedar, cream and a bitter cocoa edge appear.
A darker turn toward toasted wood and earth, with orange still in play and the pepper a little stronger.

the-tabernacle--the-tabernacle-david-gol.description: Announced by Foundation Cigar Co. in October 2020, David and Goliath are two perfectos, 5 x 54 and 5 x 58, in the original Tabernacle blend: Connecticut Broadleaf over a Mexican San Andrés binder with Nicaraguan and Honduran filler, rolled at A.J. Fernandez in Estelí. The tapered foot opens on cocoa and earth before pepper and leather take hold.

thirds.notes: Cocoa and earth come first through the tapered foot, with pepper and a hint of citrus or dark fruit behind.
Earth takes the lead and the pepper grows; leather and dark coffee appear, softened by a creamy sweetness.
Cocoa returns beside earth and leather, with dark coffee and pepper carrying a long finish.

the-tabernacle--the-tabernacle-knight-co.description: A yearly limited edition in The Tabernacle family, announced in 2023 and capped at 700 boxes of twelve, named for the Ethiopian honor awarded to Nicholas Melillo. Connecticut Broadleaf wraps a San Andrés binder and Estelí and Jalapa filler, made at A.J. Fernandez. Mocha, cedar and baking spice open the smoke, then coffee and pepper build toward the end.

thirds.notes: Mocha, earth and baking spice, with cocoa soon in front and cedar and pepper rising through the nose.
The mocha separates into coffee and cocoa, coffee now leading over cedar, pepper and a little more spice.
Pepper climbs to sit beside the coffee, with cocoa, cedar and earth underneath to a cool finish.
